posts.description: The articles in this Writing Slowly post validates my recent behavior: my most used app at work is iA Writer not Figma or GitHub Copilot . What I create starts as writing or doodling. This is thinking . Letting a machine make a bad layout with a single sentence is not the path to good design.

This unsourced map of China’s rail system is fascinating. For a month in 2008 I visited my (from Chicago) cousins in Shanghai. I wonder if I’d even recognize the spots I visited nearly 20 years later.

Louie on Mastodon : Every single time inspiration strikes and I reach for my iPad mini, it’s at 0% battery. Too true. I am trying the new iPad mini and I’m going to take drastic measures (auto airplane mode, no notifications, no background updates, etc) to reduce the likelihood of the dreaded 0%.
